_doc: Wiring-pending allowlist for scripts/checks/mode-lifecycle-hooks-coverage.js (E-LIFECYCLE-001 / S-LC-02). A declared virtual lifecycle event with NO emitter yet (no `lifecycle-events.emit("<event>")` reference and no runtime `lifecycle-event` record) is reported as INFO — not a gap — IF it is listed here with a reason. This is the RAMP seam: S-LC-02 builds the registry + logger + enforcer but NOT the emitters (the 2 REAL PreToolUse guards + the mode-switch/teardown/init/session wiring are S-LC-03/04). As each emit-site lands, PRUNE its entry here; once an event has a real emitter the enforcer counts it covered and the allowlist entry is redundant. A declared event that is NEITHER emitted NOR listed here is a real coverage GAP (report-only this sprint; --enforce makes it exit 1). Mirrors the MIGRATION_PENDING / flag-don't-fix-known-debt pattern (mode-lifecycle-registry, cutover-completeness).
